fun_facts: Brian Thomas Jr. is from Walker, Louisiana.
He played three seasons at LSU and earned second-team All-SEC and third-team All-America honors in 2023.
In 2023, he led the FBS with 17 receiving touchdowns and tied for the third-fastest 40-yard dash at the NFL Combine.
In 2024, he set Jaguars rookie records for receptions (87), receiving yards (1,282), and touchdowns (10).
His 85-yard touchdown reception against the Colts was the longest by a rookie in Jaguars franchise history.
He was named to the 2025 Pro Bowl Games and was a finalist for the 2024 AP Offensive Rookie of the Year award.

excerpts:
**JACKSONVILLE –** The Jaguars focused on offensive skill in Round 1.

They stayed busy on Day 1 again, too.

Brian Thomas Jr., a wide receiver from Louisiana State University, on Thursday night was selected by the Jaguars No. 23 overall in the 2024 NFL Draft. The Jaguars traded from No. 17 overall to acquire the selection.

The Jaguars traded No. 17 to the Minnesota Vikings and received from the Vikings Selection No. 23 (Round 1) and No. 167 (Round 5) in the 2024 NFL Draft and third- and fourth-round selections in the '25 draft.

This marked the third consecutive draft in which Jaguars General Manager Trent Baalke executed a Round 1 trade.
